title: settings.json
description: Live behaviour file. Re-read on change. Names env vars for keys; never holds a key or token.

mode.description: stock: Honcho dreams on its own and the scheduler sleeps. scheduler: the scheduler queues dreams and the hook runs only those marked by it.

logs.description: Optional rotation for policy-used.log, runs.log, dream-nas.log and restart.log. Defaults are max_mb 10 and keep 1.

max_mb.description: Rotate a log once it grows past this many megabytes.

keep.description: How many rotated files to keep, from .1 up to .keep.

effort.description: none (thinking off), minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max. Request effort wins over the backend default.

brief.description: Maximum new conclusions in a dream brief.

rounds.description: Tool-iteration cap for one dream pass.

modelName.description: Model id sent to the backend. Placeholders may contain spaces.

keyEnv.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the key; it must end in _KEY. The key itself stays in the environment.

briefTokens.description: Token budget for new conclusions in one dream (Honcho dream.brief_max_new_conclusion_tokens).

toolCalls.description: Tool-call cap for one dream (Honcho dream.max_tool_iterations).

notesMode.description: Working notes during the dream (Honcho dream.notes_mode).

notesTokens.description: Working notes size in tokens (Honcho dream.notes_max_tokens).

budget.description: Show the model its remaining budget (Honcho dream.budget_enabled).

writeWindow.description: Last rounds in which the model may still write (Honcho dream.write_window_iterations).

rerankGlobal.description: Global rerank settings for the honcho_rerank component, read by the API and the deriver (hot, on file change). The per-dream blocks (rerankOverride) replace these keys for one dream. Names, types and ranges follow the component's RerankSettings. Never holds a key: it is RERANK_API_KEY in the environment of both containers.

enabled.description: Rerank the searches listed in callers.

base_url.description: API root without /rerank: http or https, a host, no credentials, query or fragment. The key is RERANK_API_KEY in the environment.

candidates.description: Pool fetched by vector search and sent to the reranker.

max_documents.description: Most documents one request may carry.

max_query_chars.description: Longer queries are cut to this many characters before the request.

timeout_seconds.description: Deadline for the counter and the HTTP call, above 0.

callers.description: Searches to rerank. Duplicate detection is never reranked.

min_score.description: Ranked results below this score are dropped.

daily_request_cap.description: Most provider requests per UTC day; 0 never calls the provider. Per-dream caps cannot exceed it.

failures_before_cooldown.description: Consecutive failures before the provider pauses. Shared by all dreams, so it is set only here.

cooldown_seconds.description: Length of the pause, 0 or more. Shared by all dreams, so it is set only here.

rerankOverride.description: Rerank fields replaced for one dream (the component's rerank settings). Each key resolves pair, then peers[observer], then peers[observed], then defaults; a key set nowhere keeps Honcho's value. Names, types and ranges follow Honcho's RerankSettings. Never an api_key: the key stays in the deriver's environment (RERANK_API_KEY).

base_url.description: API root without /rerank: http or https, a host, no credentials, query or fragment, as the component's base_url rule. The key is RERANK_API_KEY in the environment.

candidates.description: Pool fetched by vector search and sent to the reranker.

max_documents.description: Most documents one request may carry.

timeout_seconds.description: Deadline for the counter and the HTTP call, above 0.

min_score.description: Ranked results below this score are dropped.

daily_request_cap.description: Most provider requests per UTC day; 0 never calls the provider.

backendRef.description: A key of providers.backends, or <backend>:<model> for one id in that backend's models list. Null inherits. validate.py checks that the name exists.

max_parallel.description: Dreams the scheduler may have queued at once.

dream_type.description: omni runs deduction and induction; card_refresh updates the peer card only.

skip.description: Pair keys the scheduler leaves out. Each key is observer/observed.

active.description: Backend used when the pair, the peer and defaults.backend are null. <backend>:<model> selects one id from that backend's models list.

timeout_seconds.description: Bridge request timeout in seconds, capped at 570 (below the OpenAI client's 600). Replaces BRIDGE_TIMEOUT.

stages.description: Hot bridge aliases. A string is backend:model with no per-job effort. An object sets that effort.

backends.description: Any number of named backends. A name is free; the kind decides the fields.

kind.description: cli-codex and cli-claude call the local CLIs. openai-compat is an OpenAI-style HTTP API. anthropic-api is the Anthropic Messages API.

model.description: Model id sent to this backend.

effort.description: Backend default effort for a CLI kind. A dream's own effort wins.

base_url.description: API origin, including the /v1 prefix when the provider uses one.

models.description: Model ids offered as <backend>:<model>. Does not change how effort is sent.

thinking_effort.description: Backend default effort for an HTTP backend. The request's own effort wins. Does not change how effort is sent; effort_style or the base_url host does.

effort_style.description: How effort reaches the provider. openai: reasoning_effort, minimal sent as low. deepseek: thinking enabled plus reasoning_effort low, high or max. openrouter: reasoning.effort, any level. glm: reasoning_effort low, high or max, only for GLM-5.2 and later. anthropic: Anthropic levels (output_config.effort on anthropic-api, reasoning_effort on openai-compat). none: no effort sent. The effort level none (thinking off) is sent as reasoning_effort none (openai, deepseek, generic), reasoning.effort none (openrouter), thinking disabled (glm from GLM-4.6 except GLM-5.3, and anthropic-api with no output_config.effort). Without it the base_url host decides (openrouter.ai, deepseek.com, z.ai, bigmodel.cn, api.openai.com), else reasoning_effort with the level unchanged.

enabled.description: False greys the backend out. The active backend stays enabled.

dreamSettings.description: Every key is optional: a key left out keeps Honcho's own value from config.toml.

enabled.description: False skips dreams whose observer or observed is this peer.
